template.description: What the participant is shown per record (ADR-057): a template over record.* (the uses:/of: fields) and config.*, in place of the field listing. The runner loads {file:} before validation.

fields.description: The fields shown to the participant (default: the uses: fields, or the of: value alone); validated as uses: (SPEC §7)

render.description: What the participant is shown per record (ADR-049): the listed fields, or the step's template: (ADR-057)

provides.description: The step's derived provides schema (ADR-033) — the menu the participant answers. Injected by the runner from the step-level provides: key — never authored inside with:.

of.description: The referent (ADR-048): the field whose value this step is about. Injected by the runner from the step-level of: key — never authored inside with:.

prompt.description: tty (default): at a terminal, `gtme run` walks the records and asks; never: every record waits in the ledger for `gtme answer` (ADR-049). The mode, never text — the text is template: (ADR-057)
